about.text: A block cheese called Energo Cheddar, launched by Frisian Flag with the producer PT Dairygold Indonesia.

sources.text: The Indonesian Wikipedia article on Frisian Flag, which lists Energo Cheddar among block cheeses and names the Dairygold partnership.
